claim: “The CEI, working with XCAM, developed and integrated the array of four EM-CCD sensors.”

suggestion.from: The CEI, working with UK detector manufacturer XCAM, developed and integrated the specialised array of four EM-CCD sensors that make up OGRE's X-ray camera system
suggestion.to: The CEI characterises and optimises the four EM-CCD sensors in OGRE's X-ray camera, which is built by the UK company XCAM
